findings.body: The import was changed from `openhuman_core::openhuman as oh` to `openhuman_core as oh`. This alters the namespace that `oh::` resolves to. All subsequent uses of `oh::` in this file (e.g., `oh::tools::traits`) will now look for items under `openhuman_core` directly rather than under `openhuman_core::openhuman`. If the `tools` module is not re-exported from the crate root, this will cause compilation errors. Please verify that the crate's module structure supports this change and that all `oh::` paths still resolve correctly.
findings.title: Verify `oh` alias resolves correctly after import change

value.summary: The change from `use openhuman_core::openhuman as oh` to `use openhuman_core as oh` alters the resolution of `oh::`. This may break compilation if `oh::tools::traits` is not directly under the crate root. Please verify the module structure.
